settings.a: Jamu is Indonesia's herbal drink tradition, made from roots, barks and leaves like turmeric and ginger. Recipes are passed down in families and sold fresh by street vendors, the mbok jamu, across Java.
Stir one stick into 250 ml of water, hot or cold. It dissolves in about ten seconds. Most people take it in the morning.

settings.q: Do you ship to my country?
settings.a: We ship to the US, Canada, the UK, the EU and Australia. Prices show in your currency, and duties are paid at checkout, so there's nothing extra to pay on delivery.
